en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Talha Bin Zayd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one who associates with an Imam<sup>asws</sup> in his<sup>asws</sup> Imamate from the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the one whose Imamate isn’t from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, would be an associater (Mushrik) with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Talha ibn Yazid from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Whoever would share the leadership of a Lead with Divine Authority without Divine authority is a polytheist.”
